title: Bigger Planets on the Map
description: Planet discs on the map tiles are larger (r15 to r24 for one planet, r21 for two, r17 for three), the resource and influence values moved out of the disc into a pill on its lower edge with 12-unit numbers (were 8), planet abbreviations are 10-11.5 units (were 8.5), legendary planets get a gold ring and a star, and the payment badge takes the pill's place. Wormholes moved to the tile's left edge. The before-* PNGs were taken with TI4_SHOT_PREFIX=before on the commit without the change; npm run screenshots -- DE regenerates the after-* PNGs from mocked fixtures.
